abilities.description: Masterful palming and misdirection honed over decades on stage.
abilities.name: Sleight of Hand

abilities.description: Choreographs distractions using trapdoors, mirrors and counterweights.
abilities.name: Stagecraft Direction

characters.arc: Starts as a controlling director who hides her plans. At the ball, when the chandeliers begin to awaken the earring, she must hand the real plan to Pell and Odalys rather than improvise alone. By trusting them to carry out their parts, she gets the earring into felt-lined darkness and ends as a leader who shares the script.
characters.description: Ringmistress and lead illusionist of the Curtain Call Company, Marguerite is a tall woman in her forties with silver-streaked auburn hair, a crimson velvet frock coat and gloves stitched with hidden pockets. A former opera prima donna who lost her voice, she rebuilt her career in sleight of hand and now runs the troupe from the Gilded Lantern Theatre, where she was raised among counterweights and mirrors.
characters.external_conflict: The Court of Gilded Masks guards the earring under blazing chandeliers while the Lanternwrights' Guild hunts her crew.
characters.flaw: She treats every crewmate as a prop in her plan and withholds her full script from them.
characters.goal: Lift the Obsidian Earring from the duchess's reliquary and return it to felt-lined darkness before it awakens.
characters.internal_conflict: She wants to be a leader who protects her crew, yet she cannot bring herself to trust them with the truth.
characters.motivation: To keep her found family safe and out of the Lanternwrights' cells after the theatre troupe tragedy that formed her childhood.
characters.name: Marguerite Vane

abilities.description: Deep knowledge of when cursed relics awaken and sleep, learned from Guild archives.
abilities.name: Relic Shadow-Lore

abilities.description: Controls aether lamps, shutters and felt screens to dim and redirect light.
abilities.name: Stage Lighting Mastery

characters.arc: Begins as a timid scholar who will not commit without proof. When the aether chandeliers flicker and the earring stirs, he acts on partial knowledge: he dims lamps and drapes guests in felt-lined curtains and screens so the crowd's shadows are shielded from bright light while the crew moves the earring into darkness. Having acted without certainty, he ends as a confident planner.
characters.description: Pell is the lanky, ink-stained lighting master and shadow-lore scholar of the Curtain Call Company, in his thirties with spectacles on a brass chain and a waistcoat of dark felt patches. A former apprentice archivist, he studied the old relic records before the Guild dismissed him, and now lights the troupe's stages and heists.
characters.external_conflict: The Lanternwrights' Guild considers him a traitor, and the ballroom's captured-lightning chandeliers work against every plan he makes.
characters.flaw: He hides behind research and refuses to act without certainty.
characters.goal: Shield the ball guests' shadows from the earring's awakening long enough for the crew to carry it out.
characters.internal_conflict: He knows relic lore better than anyone but fears his knowledge will fail when lives depend on it.
characters.motivation: To redeem himself for the archive accident that cost a colleague her shadow.
characters.name: Pell Ashgrove

abilities.description: Builds and repairs steam and clockwork mechanisms, including her own prosthetic hand.
abilities.name: Clockwork Engineering

characters.arc: Starts as a risk-taker who needs to be indispensable. When the Order's sabotage jams her lock mid-ball, she chooses to retreat and pass the job to Marguerite's backup plan rather than force it. She finishes as a crewmate who accepts being supported.
characters.description: Odalys is the troupe's clockwork engineer and lockbreaker, a broad-shouldered woman in her late twenties with oil-darkened hands, copper-lensed goggles and a mechanical left hand she built herself. Raised in the Sunken Arcade's black markets, she knows every route into guarded vaults.
characters.external_conflict: The Order of the Silent Overture has bribed arcade brokers to sabotage her tools.
characters.flaw: She is reckless with her own safety and tends to prove her worth by taking needless risks.
characters.goal: Defeat the reliquary's glass-and-clockwork lock and rig an escape route through the aerie's mooring lines.
characters.internal_conflict: She wants belonging but secretly believes she is valuable only when useful.
characters.motivation: To earn a permanent place in a family after a childhood of selling parts to strangers.
characters.name: Odalys Crowe

abilities.description: Reads and manipulates the masked aristocracy with theatrical wit.
abilities.name: Court Intrigue

abilities.description: Directs a well-drilled household guard and clockwork attendants.
abilities.name: Command of Servants

characters.arc: Begins as a proud host who dismisses warnings. When the chandeliers dim and the earring stirs, she sees her own shadow thin and has to order the lights put out and the relic surrendered. She ends as a humbled noble who values her life over her status.
characters.description: The mistress of the Aerie, Ilvane is a poised woman in her fifties with a pearl-white mask on a gold stick, a gown of black brocade and a collector's cold smile. She raised her floating ballroom and bought the Obsidian Earring at auction to display her house's rank.
characters.external_conflict: The Curtain Call Company targets her relic and the Order of the Silent Overture pressures her to let it awaken.
characters.flaw: Vanity makes her ignore warnings that threaten her image.
characters.goal: Show the earring at her ball and catch the thieves she expects to come for it.
characters.internal_conflict: She fears losing her shadow and rank, yet cannot bear to hide the artifact that makes her envied.
characters.motivation: To secure her house's status against rivals by owning the most dangerous curse in Velmire.
characters.name: Duchess Ilvane Marchetti

abilities.description: Identifies cursed antiquities and their awakening conditions by inspection.
abilities.name: Occult Appraisal

abilities.description: Moves signals through fog by whisper and signal lantern.
abilities.name: Whispered Network

characters.arc: Starts as a serene believer. When Pell's felt screens begin to dim the ballroom and a hooded follower of his starts to fade, he must choose between completing the awakening and saving her. He ends by abandoning the plan to pull her from the light.
characters.description: Severin is the hushed archivist-priest of the Order of the Silent Overture, a gaunt man in his sixties in grey wool with a lantern-shaped pendant and a voice rarely above a whisper. He moves between the Sunken Arcade and the Aerie posing as an appraiser.
characters.external_conflict: The Curtain Call Company and the Lanternwrights' Guild both try to keep the relic dormant.
characters.flaw: Zealotry blinds him to the human cost, including his own followers.
characters.goal: Ensure the Obsidian Earring is exposed to the crowd and bright light and the heist fails.
characters.internal_conflict: He has doubts after seeing a follower fade, and suppresses them.
characters.motivation: To witness the awakening he believes will complete the Order's centuries of devotion.
characters.name: Severin Hollow

abilities.description: Uses felt seals and silence to lull cursed relics back to sleep.
abilities.name: Relic Wardcraft

abilities.description: Follows quarry by signal lantern and sound discipline.
abilities.name: Tracking in Fog

characters.arc: Begins as an uncompromising jailer. When the earring stirs at the ball and Marguerite's crew prove they can return it to felt-lined darkness, he lets them take it to the Vault instead of arresting them. He ends as a warden willing to cooperate.
characters.description: Thaddeus is the senior warden of the Lanternwrights' Guild, a stern man in his fifties with a clockwork shoulder brace, a brass lantern staff and a ledger of every sealed relic. He keeps watch at the Velvet Vault, whose felt walls are failing.
characters.external_conflict: The thieves keep outmaneuvering him and the Order infiltrates his vaults.
characters.flaw: Rigid adherence to oath makes him blind to allies outside the Guild.
characters.goal: Capture the Curtain Call Company and secure the earring in a reinforced vault.
characters.internal_conflict: He knows the Vault is failing but cannot admit the Guild's methods are not enough.
characters.motivation: To honour the Guild's oath to keep relics sealed and prevent a repeat of the theatre troupe tragedy.
characters.name: Warden Thaddeus Brass

relationships.description: Marguerite Vane relies on Pell Ashgrove's lore but keeps his role hidden, creating friction until she shares the plan.
Marguerite Vane took Odalys Crowe in from the Sunken Arcade and mentors her, while Odalys over-risks to prove she deserves it.
Marguerite Vane targets Duchess Ilvane's earring, and the Duchess sets a trap to catch her.
Severin Hollow flatters Duchess Ilvane into keeping the earring on bright display so it awakens.
Severin Hollow bribes brokers to sabotage Odalys Crowe's tools, jamming the reliquary lock.
Warden Thaddeus Brass hunts Marguerite Vane for meddling with relics, until the ball forces an uneasy cooperation.
Warden Thaddeus Brass sees his former archive apprentice Pell Ashgrove as a traitor to the Guild.
